title: [SOLO] H-REPORTLOSS-1 leg 2 - the upload budget and the outbox cap. With the stub failing every upload: (a) `bugbudget 1500` makes the host's report leave its saves out while keeping the reporter's Player.log; (b) five failed reports leave exactly 3 pending - the two oldest are dropped (and logged) as reports 4 and 5 are filed - the bug-reports folder stays under 30 MB, and a freshly launched instance reports `Outbox: 3 pending`. L15: every failure is a 429 with Retry-After 90, and the scheduled next attempt must be at least 90 s after the last one (the normal gap is 60 s).
preconditions: SOLO VARIANT (2026-09-23): the rig's client install is a different game build from the host (b3680 vs b3682 after a game update; sync-test-rig.ps1 -Check fails), so the client cannot join. The client instance is closed FIRST (it shares the bug-reports folder and would also run retries) and the host plays alone: the save attach is then 1 .hsg for 1 player and no peer logs are asked for. Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1). OPERATOR SETUP OUTSIDE THE RUN: tools/report_stub.py running on a port NOT used by any earlier run, mode `429 90` (every upload fails with 429 and Retry-After: 90 - L15); all three BigAmbitionsMP.cfg.*.json files carry "BugReportRelayUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:<that port>/" (restore the previous value after the run). Dev build with the bugreport + bugbudget levers (BAMP_DEV). Reports are filed one after another, each only after the previous one's attempt 1 has failed, so no folder is locked (in use) when the next report's prune runs; the five reports take about a minute, less than the 1-minute retry gap, so no retry holds a folder the prune must drop.
oracles_absent: \[BugReport\] (upload task|outbox pass|outbox launch pass|save store attach|save attach players|zip bundle failed|zip rebuild failed|bundle plan failed|report prune|prune ')
